prompt:
Original Taiwanese game art for "Tainan Gazetteer" (府城夜巡地圖), set in Tainan around 1930.
Style: handmade layered paper sculpture (紙雕 / kirie), the same for buildings, trees, plants,
fences and props. Every shape is a piece of cut paper: visible paper fibres, slightly soft
hand-cut edges, pieces overlapping in shallow layers with small soft contact shadows where one
sheet sits on another. Colour is printed on the paper: clearly visible risograph / stencil print
grain and uneven ink density across every flat area, never a clean digital fill.
Details are built from small cut pieces (roof tiles, bricks, window frames, leaves, petals,
wood planks), not painted lines.
Colour: follow the real object, then mute it: pale, slightly greyed, warm. Typical tones: warm
cream, pale brick red, coral, sage and grey-green, mustard, indigo, wood brown, stone grey.
No saturated red-against-green contrast.
Do NOT make: a 3D render or clay/plastic model, smooth bevelled relief, realistic or painterly
illustration, photo textures, thick foam layers, glow, glossy highlights, black outline strokes,
smooth gradients, depth of field.
Output: generated natively on a fully TRANSPARENT background (real alpha, no chroma-key colour
behind it, no coloured fringe), every object complete and separated by clear transparent
gutters, no ground, no base, no cast shadow outside the object, no text, no captions, no logos.
View: front-facing, very slight three-quarter, the same for every object on the sheet.

REQUEST 16-literature-trial. Create one original game sprite of the National Museum of Taiwan Literature (historic Tainan Prefectural Hall). The two first image inputs, machiya.png and shennong.png, are the approved style exemplars: match their hand-cut construction, actual paper fibre, tactile mottled stencil-print ink and grain, and slightly irregular cut edges, as if made by the same artist with the same sheets of paper. Reference images 3 and 4 give the actual building anatomy only. Rebuild the entire subject from flat shapes with the first two images as the style anchor.

For this sprite the view is strictly orthographic front elevation, overriding the general slight three-quarter instruction above. Camera perpendicular to facade, no perspective whatsoever. All verticals parallel, all horizontal sill and cornice edges horizontal. No exposed left or right sides, no visible horizontal top faces of roof, stairs, plinths or ledges, no portico ceiling, no diagonal face of any protrusion. Even the two round domed towers are flat front silhouettes with straight horizontal bands. Represent the sloping FRONT silhouette of the large grey-green mansard roof with cut sheet seams and a single central dormer, no visible roof top planes. Keep symmetrical compact building outline with width about 4:3 relative to height, central entry plus only short wings and one domed corner tower on each side.

The image is a thin handmade paper collage of three to four flat stacked planes: the grey-white first-floor stone and pale muted brick-red second-floor walls, the cut-out window frames and paired pale columns, the central entry portico, and the grey-green roof paper. Render the arched upper window, triangular pediment, central door, paired columns and simplified cut-paper Ionic scrolls. Separate brick pieces with subtle uneven paper seams, use open cut-paper window lattice over dark muted paper, and show cut-paper grain even on the smallest details. All pillars are flat single-color strip silhouettes with fibres, not rounded and shaded. Steps are flat horizontal strips. Cornices are simple thin strips with no beveled faces. Use only tiny soft contact shade at overlapping paper seams, absolutely no volumetric shading, surface lighting, rounded molding or stone relief. Grey-white stone on the full ground floor, pale brick red confined to upper wall fields, ivory-grey trim, muted pale verdigris roof. Strongly visible fine paper fibres and uneven printed ink on all flat areas like the approved sprites, crisp legibility at game size.

One complete facade, with generous clear alpha margin on all sides. No vegetation, ground, separate base, cast exterior shadow, signage, text or logos. Native transparent PNG alpha.

Make the manual collage effect unmistakable. Imagine it laid flat on a scanner: uniform flat exposure on the whole facade. Eliminate the rows of bulky dentil blocks and replace moldings by flat single strips. Make the stone lightly flecked cool grey, with sparse fine slab joins. The corner towers have completely straight horizontal trim bands, with a simply cut dome above, as depicted in a straight-on paper illustration. Use the darker brown door and warm grey, muted dusty coral and faded grey-green of the supplied description. Enforce edge cleanliness: every pixel beyond the cut-paper silhouette is completely transparent, including the entire clear perimeter. Keep the sprite width approximately 1.32 times its height.

Keep a wide transparent safety margin, especially below the entrance steps. Previous generations had stray bright red, yellow and white pixels on the cutout border. For this clean production cutout, all outer antialiasing must be the same muted paper RGB as the adjacent interior with smoothly decreasing native alpha. No floating fragments, colored edge artifacts, opaque fringe, or speckles outside the art. Make the central roof extend higher than the domes. The big central triangular pediment sits ABOVE the large arched window, and the entry portico BELOW the window is flat-topped. Score the muted dusty red wall pieces into a very fine readable brick pattern using subtle individual paper joins.
notes: 使用內建 image_gen，直接送入 public/art/tainan/machiya.png 與 public/art/tainan/shennong.png 作為風格參考，並送入 literature-photo.jpg 與 literature-aerial.jpg 作為建築參考。另查閱 art-source/refs/literature-side.jpg、literature-illustration.jpg 及 15-redo-paper/literature.png 的配色與比例。網路實景參考：https://www.twtainan.net/zh-tw/attractions/detail/1142/ 、https://museums.moc.gov.tw/EN/MusData/Detail?museumsId=fc6353f7-4b25-4db2-bdfa-927fa43f496b 。試稿保留原生 alpha，局部輪廓仍見彩色殘邊，待 Claude 驗收。
